faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating between English and German.

items.q: Does it handle formal Sie and casual du correctly?
items.a: Yes, translations reflect the level of formality in your sentence rather than defaulting to one form.

items.q: Can it translate spoken German back to English?
items.a: Yes — speak German into the mic and get an English translation as text, with audio playback available.

items.q: Does it get long German compound words right?
items.a: Yes, it translates compound words as whole terms with the correct meaning, not word-by-word fragments.
Yes. The service is free for everyone — no subscription and no quota. Sign in with email, Google or Apple only if you want your history attached to an account instead of this browser.

items.q: Do I need a German keyboard for umlauts?
items.a: No, the app handles ä, ö, ü, and ß automatically — no special keyboard needed.

items.q: Can I hear how the German translation is pronounced?
items.a: Yes, tap the speaker icon on any translation to hear it read aloud.
